lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Visible as four distinct horizontal rows of high-luminance circular spots, arranged in roughly vertical columns starting posterior to the gill slits and extending toward the caudal peduncle.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity are clearly visible, intersecting the horizontal rows of circular blobs to create a structured, grid-like nodal pattern across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A dominant linear ridge is visible running longitudinally along the upper flank, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient with a highlight on the dorsal-facing edge and a dark shadow on the ventral-facing edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The first dorsal fin contains a sparse distribution of approximately 8-10 low-to-medium intensity white spots scattered across its lateral silhouette, primarily concentrated in the middle and posterior regions.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Three distinct elongated ectoparasites or commensals (remoras) are visible trailing from the posterior margin of the pectoral fin. A minor indentation is present on the posterior trailing edge of the first dorsal fin.
other_distinctive_markers: The rostrum and the leading edge of the pectoral fin exhibit a significantly higher density of micro-scale, high-luminance spots compared to the larger, more spaced-out blobs on the main flank.
